messages:
Chris (Support): Escalating VerdeAnalytics pilot - customers are seeing incorrect search hits after our recent embedding rollout. Pilot users report ~20% of queries returning unrelated docs. Renewal touch in 10 days, pilot at-risk. @Ivy can you own? :warning:
Ivy (CS): Ack. Need repro examples, scope (how many tenants/sessions), timeline, and a comms plan. Suggest immediate ack + temporary rollback/fallback + 1:1 enablement to rebuild confidence. @Marta please standby for customer comms.
Ben (Solutions): Likely culprit: embedding model variant mismatch or post-quantization drift. Chris paste a failed query, the expected doc id, and returned doc ids. Also share tenant id and ingestion window.
Chris (Support): Ticket 91110. Sample: query "contract termination notice" expected doc id=doc-981, returned top results: doc-432, doc-77 (unrelated). Tenant=verde-pilot-3, issue noticed after embedding version v3.1 deployed at 2026-06-10T02:10Z. Short repro attached.
Marta (Account): I'll own comms. Draft plan: 1) immediate ack + interim workaround (route this tenant to v2 embeddings) 2) offer to run a live reindex/rebuild with CS & Solutions 3) schedule 30m enablement + collect feedback on docs. Owner=Marta (comms), tech=Ben, CS=Ivy. Renewal_flag=true until resolved.
alerts-bot: Runbook: embedding regressions -> https://redwood.runbooks/embed-regress (link)
Ben (Solutions): Quick mitigation: enable routing rule to pin verde-pilot-3 to embedding v2 (no reindex required for v2 if we keep original vectors). That buys time for a controlled reindex using v3.1 fix. I can toggle routing; will need infra oncall for the route change.
Ivy (CS): Perfect. Also prepare a short enablement checklist: 1) confirm search expectations 2) run test-query suite together 3) review reindex schedule and fallback plan 4) capture eval set for postmortem.
Chris (Support): I paged infra oncall at 09:16 and attached ticket + logs. Manual test: pinned tenant to v2 locally and test queries returned expected docs for sample repro. Will keep monitoring.
Marta (Account): Drafted email at 09:25: "Hi Verde team — we're investigating your search results. Short-term we can route your workspace back to the previous embeddings to restore expected behavior and run a reindex with you. Can we book a 30m call?" Sending now.
Ben (Solutions): Infra oncall approved routing change. Pinning tenant to v2 now. I also opened PR #2107 to patch v3.1 quantization path; ETA for staged deploy 6h. I'll schedule a controlled reindex job and estimate ~40-90 minutes depending on document count; will share exact ETA after calculating shard sizes.
Chris (Support): Update 09:40 — routing change live, sample repro queries now match expected results. Monitoring search latencies and recall for 2h.
Ivy (CS): Great. Marta schedule the 30m enablement today. On the call we should run the customer's test-suite and confirm acceptance criteria for reindex. Also ask them for a prioritized list of queries to include in our eval harness.
Marta (Account): Booked call at 11:00 local. Customer accepted and asked whether rollback affects analytics. I'm sending a clarifying note that analytics remain intact; only embedding variant changed. Also capturing feedback request: clearer guidance on embedding version changes in release notes.
Ben (Solutions): Calculated reindex estimate: verde-pilot-3 doc-count ~320k, estimated reindex 55m with parallel workers; scheduling window 13:00 UTC. Will give heads-up 30m before and offer to run with customer on the call.
Chris (Support): While pinned to v2, no further complaints from pilot users. Ticket updated and linked to thread.
Ivy (CS): After the enablement call, runbook: confirm post-reindex queries pass, collect acceptance sign-off, then switch routing to v3.1 once patch is deployed to canary and we validate. Also log feedback: docs that show how to interpret embedding-version impact. Owner for postmortem and docs = Ivy. ETA 3 business days.
Marta (Account): Post-call notes: customer satisfied with fallback and appreciated fast response. They want clearer release-notes and a preflight similarity checker to warn when new embeddings change top-k. Capturing as product/feedback item.
Ben (Solutions): Reindex started at 13:00 UTC; monitoring progress. Canary deploy of v3.1 patch scheduled in parallel. Will not flip routing until we validate sample test-suite on canary.
Chris (Support): Reindex completed 13:56. Quick verification: test-suite pass rate 99.2% against expected top-5.
Ben (Solutions): Canary validated, sample-suite green. Flipping routing to v3.1 for verde-pilot-3 now. Will monitor for regression for 1h.
Ivy (CS): Monitoring looks stable. Customer reports search returning expected docs. Renewal_flag cleared but will keep a follow-up 1-week check-in to ensure retention. Final items: Ivy to publish postmortem + onboarding note; Ben to add a preflight similarity check to the ingestion pipeline; Marta to send a summary to customer. Thanks all. :tada:
